# sentry_project (Data Source)

Looks up a project by slug or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sentry_project" "api" {
  slug = "api"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Project ID. Set this or `slug`.
- `slug` (String) Project slug. Set this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Name of the project.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the project, if one is set.
- `team_ids` (List of String) IDs of the teams with access to the project, sorted.
